name: Incremental Refactor: focusStack to RGA64Stack (Multi-phase)
summary: Refactor World class to use RGA64Stack instead of FormaList for the focus stack. This involves updating initialization, mutation methods (focusForma, unfocusForma), retrieval methods (focusedForma, focusOrder), and persistence logic (toJSON/fromJson).

rawActions.name: Add RGA64Stack as shadow stack
rawActions.summary: Add #rgaFocusStack property initialized as new RGA64Stack({ name: 'Focus Stack' }). In World.fromJSON(), if rgaFocusStack is empty but focusStack has entries, sync by pushing each forma id into rgaFocusStack.

rawActions.name: Update mutations for shadowing
rawActions.summary: Modify focusForma and unfocusForma in World.ts to perform updates on both the original #focusStack and the new #rgaFocusStack.
rawActions.statusNote: Setting status to done as requested.

rawActions.name: Implement remove(value) in RGA64Stack
rawActions.summary: Add a new method `remove(value: UUID64)` to `RGA64Stack` that searches the stack for a node containing the specified value and marks it as deleted (tombstone) if found. This is required to support the "rearrange" behavior in World.ts.
